calendarDate.description: Candidate source for the test date currently read from nonexistent testDate/date/dateTime keys (bug #56).

speed.description: Unit: m/s (NOT s/m as the current code comment assumes). Should be consumed as lt_pace_s_per_km via 1000.0 / speed, not speed * 1000.0 (bug #56: code currently reads nonexistent top-level paceThreshold and multiplies instead of dividing).

heartRate.description: Should be consumed as lt_hr_bpm (bug #56: code currently reads nonexistent top-level heartRateThreshold instead).

power.description: Functional threshold power data — separate from the HR/pace threshold, not currently modeled by any sync.py field.

title: Lactate threshold (get_lactate_threshold)
description:
Returned by garminconnect's get_lactate_threshold() — no date argument, most-recent test only. CRITICAL: sync_lactate_threshold currently reads heartRateThreshold/paceThreshold/testDate — NONE of these keys exist in the real response (see bug #56). Real shape is nested under speed_and_heart_rate and power.

Verified against: most-recent test on this account, dated 2026-07-06 (speed_and_heart_rate) / 2026-07-19 (power) — the two sub-objects have different calendarDates, meaning unconfirmed (possibly last-updated timestamps for that specific metric, not the same test). Additional fields beyond what's listed here may exist and are tolerated (additionalProperties: true) — Garmin adding new fields is not a breaking change; a listed field disappearing or changing type is.
